page_title: RMA 4-0 CEL | Real Madrid v Celta Vigo 10/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' 4 - 0 Arda Guler (Real Madrid) is released by Dani Ceballos, he surges into the box and smashes a great shot into the net after a one-on-one with the goalkeeper.
90+3' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) attempts to find Joselu, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Vinicius Junior departs the field of play to be replaced by Arda Guler (Real Madrid).
88' Here is a change. Eduardo Camavinga is going off and Carlo Ancelotti gives the last tactical orders to Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid).
88' 3 - 0 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it into the bottom right corner of his own goal.
87' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
86' Joselu (Real Madrid) dribbles into the box, but Vicente Guaita is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
83' Substitution. Jorgen Strand Larsen leaves the pitch and is replaced by Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo).
83' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) replacing Luka Modric.
83' It will be a substitution. Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) is ready to enter the pitch as Brahim Diaz walks off.
82' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Javier Manquillo (Celta Vigo) is given a yellow card.
79' 2 - 0 Vicente Guaita (Celta Vigo) scores an unfortunate own goal after deflecting the ball into his own net!
79' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) sees his header crash off the crossbar after meeting a corner kick inside the six-yard box. The goalkeeper would have been helpless.
79' Corner kick. Luka Modric (Real Madrid) is ready to send the ball into the box.
79' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
77' Rafael Benitez has decided to make a change. Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo) replaces Fran Beltran.
77' The manager makes a subsitution with Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) coming on for Oscar Mingueza.
76' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) takes the corner with a short pass.
76' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The ball is out of play. Celta Vigo win a corner kick.
75' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Nacho Fernandez (Real Madrid), but it's just over the bar.
75' There's an opportunity for Luka Modric (Real Madrid) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

75' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
74' Joselu (Real Madrid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rodrygo.
73' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
72' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) and Iago Aspas combine well with a quick one-two to trick their opponent.

68' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) rifles a low drive from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic reflex save.
66' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots low towards the middle of the goal. Vicente Guaita is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
66' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
65' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
63' Celta Vigo seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
60' Rafael Benitez decides to make a substitution. Manu Sanchez will be replaced by Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo).
60' We are about to witness a substitution. Tadeo Allende (Celta Vigo) is replacing Jonathan Bamba.
59' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls it and sends it straight at Vicente Guaita, who makes a comfortable save.

58' The most active player in today's match is definitely Luka Modric (Real Madrid). He's trying to be on the ball as much as possible and you can literally see the enthusiasm in his play. He keeps exchanging some one touch passes and waits for the right moment to send a killer pass. What a player!
56' The foul by Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) was seen by Mario Melero Lopez who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
55' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
55' What was Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
54' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
54' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle for a foul. Celta Vigo have a free kick.
53' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
51' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) sends a superb lead pass into the penalty area and finds Jorgen Strand Larsen, who fails to shoot.
48' That's unlucky! Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
48' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
47' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+1' Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) shows good awareness deep inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the resulting free kick. He jumps high but his towering header lacks accuracy and flies well over the crossbar.
45+1' Mario Melero Lopez shows a yellow card to Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) for his blatant foul.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.

43' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle for an infringement. There is a free kick near the sideline to Celta Vigo.
42' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
40' 9:0 – the corner kicks stats.
38' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the bottom left corner lacks power and Andriy Lunin easily makes the save.

37' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going inside the left post, but Vicente Guaita has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.

35' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Vicente Guaita leaps like a salmon to deny him.
34' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header way over the bar. What a poor effort.
34' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
34' The ball is cleared after Rodrygo (Real Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play and Real Madrid manage to earn a corner.
31' Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle and it's Nacho Fernandez (Real Madrid) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
31' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
30' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) passes the ball onto Rodrygo, but one of the defenders dispossesses him. Real Madrid earn a corner.
29' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
29' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
28' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Vicente Guaita intercepts the ball. Real Madrid get a corner.
26' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the right post.
25' Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mario Melero Lopez had an easy-decision to make.
24' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
21' 1 - 0 Goal! Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 1:0.
21' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a low header towards middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes to stop the effort.
21' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

21' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) connects with an accurate pass inside the box and fires the ball to the bottom right corner, but one of the defending players steps in to block the effort. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Real Madrid.
18' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
18' A pass by Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
17' 76:24 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
15' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
13' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) sends a low pass from outside the box to Lucas Vazquez. He lines up a shot, but the defence intercepts at the last moment.
12' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
10' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) brings his opponent down. Mario Melero Lopez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Real Madrid.
9' Manu Sanchez (Celta Vigo) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies miles wide of the right post.
8' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Luka Modric (Real Madrid). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

7' What a great chance for Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header right under the bar, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save. It will be a corner kick for Real Madrid.
7' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) prepares to take a corner kick.

6' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. Good work from Real Madrid as they win a corner.
5' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes a short corner kick.

4' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat. The ball goes out for a corner. Real Madrid can continue in their attacking effort.
4' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee points to the corner flag and Real Madrid will take a corner.

3' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and towards the left post. It would have probably ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Vicente Guaita and his brilliant save.
3' The Real Madrid players are exchanging some short passes.
2' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
1' The match has just started.
Real Madrid will kick the game off.
Mario Melero Lopez will referee today's match.
